title: Rabbi Yose bar Aivu
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Bereshit Rabbah 34:13](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.34.13) mentions him speaking in the name of Rabbi Yochanan. Hyman suggests he may be the one named Rav Yosef bar Abba in [Berakhot 59b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.59b.16), speaking in the name of Rabbi Yochanan. Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim, however, reads simply Rav Yosef, as also cited by [Rashbam on Pesachim 101a](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashbam_on_Pesachim.101a.10.2).[^1]

notes.text: Bereshit Rabbah names Rabbi Yosi bar Aivu. The consulted Bavli reads Rabbi Yosef bar Abba. Rashbam gives Rav Yosef. Hyman proposes identifying the figures.
